title: Asaph
summary: Raleigh names Asaph in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Asaph the sonne of Barachia, on whom the 50. and the 72. Psalme with the ten that follow are bestowed. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. VIII, sig. 299b
